cloud-dreamer-blanket.title: Cloud Dreamer Blanket

specs.label: Feel
specs.value: Plush and velvety on both sides, four-way stretch

specs.label: Care
specs.value: Machine wash cold, hang to dry

featureHighlights.label: Plush that feels the same in every position
featureHighlights.body: Velvety on the inside and the outside, with no rough seams or scratchy edges — whichever way you flip it, it is the soft side.

featureHighlights.label: Four-way stretch, made to hug
featureHighlights.body: The spandex blend moves with you and settles around your shoulders without sagging, bunching or losing its shape.

featureHighlights.label: Comes out of the wash just as soft
featureHighlights.body: Wash cold on its own, hang to dry, then give it a shake. It returns exactly the way you left it.

perks: Four-way stretch that holds its shape
Four sizes, from throw to king
Easy to gift, easy to match any room
